name: Postknight World
detailed_description:
A heartwarming open-world RPG about slowing down, delivering stories, and savoring life’s little moments.

A Postknight’s Journey: Deliveries That Matter

• As a Postknight, every delivery is more than just a task—every knightmail holds a story, and every recipient has a past.
• Travel across Prism, from lively villages to quiet mountain hamlets, discovering places filled with warmth, wonder, and untold tales.

Embrace the Beauty of the Journey

• Life isn’t just about the destination—it’s about the quiet moments in between.
• Watch petals drift in the wind, feel the glow of lanterns at dusk, and share silent companionship with a fellow traveler on the road.
• Not every adventure is grand. Some are about simply being—and finding meaning in the smallest encounters.

A Home Wherever You Roam

• Set up your mobile campsite anywhere—deep in a forest, by a riverside, or in the heart of a bustling town.
• Personalize it with keepsakes, little comforts, and a warm fire to return to after each journey.

Discover, Connect, and Bond

• Forge friendships with villagers, wanderers, and fellow Postknights—each with their own stories to tell.
• Over time, people will recognize you, trust you, and open up in ways that feel real and personal.

A World Full of Simple Pleasures

• Gather rare herbs, hand-forged trinkets, and handwritten notes that hold sentimental value.
• Savour life’s small joys—a warm meal at an inn, fireflies dancing at night, or the distant hum of a bard’s song.

A Living, Breathing World

• Towns have their own traditions, festivals, and daily routines that shift over time.
• Deliveries may spark reunions, change lives, or even shape the fate of a village.
• Some stories are given. Others are waiting to be discovered.

Deliveries, Memories, and Quiet Adventures Await

Postknight World is a journey about more than just delivering letters—it’s about the connections you make, the stories you uncover, and the world that remembers you, even after your travels are done.
